chapter: Harry James, Bellson and the return to Duke
title: Duke's kindness during Rose's operation
summary: Duke sent $1,000, fruit and flowers when Rose had surgery, though he would not loan the $3,000 for the house.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You mentioned that he was so concerned about Rose when she had an operation, and he sent money.
Yeah, he sent me a thousand dollars.
A thousand dollars, and sent me beautiful fruit and beautiful flowers.

And when I was leaving the band and I told him I wanted $3,000, for you to loan me $3,000 -- because I don't want to lose my home. And he said, 'Well, you shouldn't worry about your home; I'll take care of that, you know? I'll see to it that you won't lose your home. See, I said, That was fine, but I already got my contract and I got to go.'
